g.text: # a room, a corridor, a 90° arch, another room

text.tspan: uedcli actor show Room_3md1kn | uedcli brush clip - --plane 240,320,160 1,1,0 --keep below \
uedcli actor show Room_3md1kn | uedcli brush clip - --plane -160,320,160 -1,1,0 --keep below \
uedcli actor show Room_3md1kn | uedcli brush clip - --plane 240,-320,160 1,-1,0 --keep below \
uedcli actor show Room_3md1kn | uedcli brush clip - --plane -160,-320,160 -1,-1,0 --keep below \
# a second corridor, out of the arch
uedcli actor prop set Corr_dw0yx8_cj19ls Rotation.Yaw=-16384
# the second room, at the arch's far end
uedcli actor prop set Room_3md1kn_qorasz Rotation.Yaw=16384
